MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFFIS SALE
25002925
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. FO0826524
WELLS FARGO BANK, N.A., is the Plaintiff, and ELIZABETH HOLICKI. ET ALS., are Defendants, writ of execution for the sale of mortgaged premises dated 09/25/2025.
By virtue of the above stated Writ, to me directed and delivered, I will expose to sale at public vendue on WEDNESDAY, the 17TH Day of DECEMBER A.D. 2025. at the hour of one thirty o' clock by the then prevailing (Standard or Daylight Saving) time, in the afternoon of the said day, at the Heldrich Hotel, 1O Livingston Ave, New Brunswick, N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located In the TOWNSHIP OF OLD BRIDGE. County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey
Premises commonly known as: 232 SILVER LN. OLD BRIDGE, NJ 08857 Tax Lot: 232, Tax Block: 16005
Dimensions: 31 FT. X 72FT.
Nearest Cross Street: STONE RIDGE RD
The occupancy status of the property is; OCCUPIED BY UNKNOWN
Plaintiff's good faith estimate of its Upset price is: $286,052.94
THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION
+SUBJECT TO ANY UNPAID TAXES, MUNICIPAL LIENS OR OTHER CHARGES, AND ANY SUCH TAXES. CHARGES. LIENS, INSURANCE PREMIUMS OR OTHER ADVANCES MADE BY PLAINTIFF PRIOR TO THIS SALE. ALL INTERESTED PARTIES ARE TO CONDUCT AND RELY UPON THEIR OWN INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATION TO ASCERTAIN WHETHER OR NOT ANY OUTSTANDING INTEREST REMAIN OF RECORD AND/OR HAVE PRIORITY OVER THE LIEN BEING FORECLOSED AND, IF SO THE CURRENT AMOUNT DUE THEREON.
**IF THE SALE IS SET ASIDE FOR ANY REASON, THE PURCHASER AT THE SALE SHALL BE ENTITLED ONLY TO A RETURN OF THE DEPOSIT PAID. THE PURCHASER SHALL HAVE NO FURTHER RECOURSE AGAINST THE MORTGAGOR, THE MORTGAGEE OR THE MORTGAGEE’S ATTORNEY,
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposIted into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for on order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the upset to be satisfied by said sale is the sum of TWO HUNDRED SIXTY FOUR THOUSAND FOUR HUNDRED NINETY ONE DOLLARS AND TWENTY NINE CENTS ($264,491.29) dollars more or less, plus interest together with the costs of this sale. THE UPSET AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to adjourn said sale from time to time subject only to such limitations or restrictions upon the exercise of such power as may be specially provided by law or rules of the Court. Sold subject to conditions of sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of bid in certifled check or official bank check at close of sale and the balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott. SherIff
Brock & Scott. PLLC
302 Fellowship Road SuIte 130 Mount Laurel. NJ 08054
Attorneys
